method: ARTIFACT (diff|spec|claim|skill output) x FAILURE (omission|fabrication|false positive) x ARRIVAL (explicit|implicit|contextual). Twelve hand-written cases: seven positives spanning the job and five near-miss negatives owned by review, real-testing, bugfix, sweep or direct execution.

cases.prompt: Run critic on this git safety guard before we promote it; use fresh context and try to find sibling destructive commands the tests forgot.
Attack this spec from a clean context before anyone implements it. I want only findings that survive a counter-argument.
The census row says the workflow validates every quoted source. Before I rely on it, independently open the artifact and prove or disprove that claim without reading the author's reasoning.
This review report cites line 41, but I suspect the quote is invented. Validate the report against the materialized bundle before promotion.
We are about to accept this migration plan. Give a fresh adversary only the plan and its contract, record what it did not open, and drop anything it cannot quote.
Use critic as the independent T3 reviewer for this SKILL.md and its eval transcript.

cases.tuple: clean artifact / false positive / names job
cases.prompt: Try to break this tiny configuration contract, but do not manufacture issues just to return a non-empty list; explain a genuine zero-finding result.
Review the finished pull request and give the merge-blocking code findings.
All checks are green; decide whether this branch can merge and deploy.
The upload endpoint returns 500. Reproduce the defect, patch it and add the regression test.
Sweep the whole repository for stale decisions and post the consolidated findings.
Rename this variable, run formatting and commit the mechanical change.
Run critic once on DEC-polaris-retrieval-002 before the founder accepts it: the CONTRACT is the three ADR tests and its probe.
